description: Your man-hours (工数) per day, project, and task, in minutes, with names when the directory can be loaded. Defaults: from=the 1st of this month, to=the end of that month (Japan time, YYYY-MM-DD), max 93 days. closed (締め) or fixed (確定) days cannot be changed with save_manhours or delete_manhours. close_out says which days are missing or off; call this to see the entries before changing them.

from.description: Start date (YYYY-MM-DD). Defaults to the 1st of this month.

to.description: End date, inclusive (YYYY-MM-DD). Defaults to the end of the month of `from`.

name: get_manhours
title: Get my man-hours
